title: TurnPanel | Bring Your AI Work Into One Workspace
excerpt: General intelligence is here, bring it home. Unify models, conversations, agents, browser activity, files, memory, and tools in one private, local-first AI workspace.
content_html:
Your AI work is scattered. Bring it into one workspace.

General intelligence is here, bring it home. Unify models, conversations, agents, browser activity, files, memory, and tools in TurnPanel.

Public beta

Download TurnPanel

Local by design

Your AI workspace.
Yours to own.

TurnPanel runs on your computer. Your memory and skills stay with your workspace, whichever model you use.

Browser automation

A built-in browser.
With an agent at the wheel.

Optimized specifically for agents to navigate, fill forms from memory, research your options, and order what you need, with human input only when it’s needed.

Built for local models

Compact page context and precise browser controls keep small models focused.

Less repeating yourself

Use remembered preferences and details to fill forms, shop, and book.

A hand only when needed

Step in for a login, payment, or confirmation. Your agent picks up from there.

Custom apps

Ask for the tool you wish existed.

Turn an idea into a real local app with remembered state, useful actions, and a responsive interface that lives inside TurnPanel.

Extension marketplace

Share a complete workflow, or install one.

Package skills, apps, scripts, spaces, and automations into an extension. Publish it to the marketplace, or download complete extensions built by others.

SkillsAppsScriptsSpacesAutomations

Explore the marketplace

Context that stays with you

It remembers you.
And builds on what works.

Your memory, files, and self-evolving skills live together on your computer, ready for the next task, even when you switch models.

Start where you left off

Start a new conversation or switch models. Your agent draws on saved preferences and relevant context, so you can pick up without explaining everything again.

Teach it once. Build on it.

Show your agent how you want a task done. With background maintenance enabled, it automatically refines the skill and applies your guidance the next time.

Keep your context yours

Your memory, files, and skills stay in your local workspace. Choose which models work with that context, without moving your working history to another app.

Your models. Your choice.

Bring your favorite model.
Or find your local match.

Start with the free TurnPanel model, bring Codex, OpenRouter, OpenCode, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, or let TurnPanel find and run a local model for your computer.

Local means yours

Run downloaded models offline, with no per-token inference charges.

Let the task choose

Hybrid routing can send more demanding work to your configured online models.

A free place to start

TurnPanel Free includes a hosted allowance, alongside your own providers and local models.

Remote access Pro

Your workspace stays home.
You can go anywhere.

Your agent, memory, and skills live on your computer. With Pro, securely reach your full workspace from any browser, phone, or other device, wherever you are.

Keep your computer on, connected to the internet, and remote access enabled.

Observability

See where every
token goes.

Understand usage across your agent, connected apps, and models. Track online spend, spot usage trends, and estimate the value of running locally.

Put local usage in perspective.

The ROI calculator compares your local-engine tokens with an online model’s rates, so you can explore estimated savings.

Local tokens×Comparison rates→Estimated online cost

An estimate, separate from actual online spend.

Keep an eye on your allowances.

Models → Usage also brings together Codex quota, the TurnPanel model allowance, and web-search usage.

  • Codex quota
  • TurnPanel model
  • Web searches

Your next idea.
Your own AI workspace.

Bring your models, teach your agent, and turn ideas into finished work with memory and skills that stay on your computer.

Download the beta
